clinical_guidelines: This document discusses cost-effectiveness and efficacy of various pharmacological treatments for heart failure.
Telmisartan in combination with angiotensin converting enzyme inhibitors and angiotensin-receptor blockers is assessed.
Beta-blockers, angiotensin-receptor blockers, and neprilysin inhibitors are evaluated for their role in the management of heart failure.
The document compares various clinical trials and assesses treatment outcomes for heart failure patients, including the use of enalapril, sacubitril/valsartan, and carvedilol.
